title: Buyer-Intent Radar Pipeline Input
description: Sweeps Reddit, Stack Overflow, and Hacker News for people actively expressing a need or buying intent on your topic, scores each lead 0-100, groups by person, and tiers them hot / warm / mention.

keywords.title: Keywords / topics
keywords.description: Product, category, or competitor terms to search across all three platforms. Examples: ["crm", "project management tool", "salesforce alternative"].

subreddits.title: Subreddits (optional)
subreddits.description: Specific subreddits to monitor in addition to the keyword search, without the r/ prefix. Examples: ["smallbusiness", "sales", "marketing"].

stackTags.title: Stack Overflow tags (optional)
stackTags.description: Stack Overflow tags to monitor in addition to the keyword search. Tag-based pulls surface people struggling with a specific technology. Examples: ["salesforce", "hubspot-api", "stripe"].

hnFeeds.title: Hacker News feeds
hnFeeds.description: Which HN feeds to pull alongside the keyword search. Valid: ask (Ask HN, the strongest intent), show, top, best, new. Default ask.

extraIntentKeywords.title: Extra intent phrases (optional)
extraIntentKeywords.description: Add your own high-intent phrases to the built-in lexicon (looking for, recommend, alternative to, best tool, switching from, pricing, and more). Useful for niche buying language or competitor product names.

includeReddit.title: Include Reddit
includeReddit.description: Pull Reddit posts (RSS feeds), pre-filtered to intent-bearing language.

includeStackOverflow.title: Include Stack Overflow
includeStackOverflow.description: Pull Stack Overflow questions (an unanswered question is an active unmet need).

includeHackerNews.title: Include Hacker News
includeHackerNews.description: Pull Hacker News Ask/Show/stories matching your keywords.

maxAgeHours.title: Max age (hours)
maxAgeHours.description: Ignore posts older than this. 168 = one week.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max items per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: Cap on raw items pulled from each platform before scoring. Higher finds more leads but raises the child per-item cost. Kept small by default so a first run is cheap; raise it for a full pull.

minIntentScore.title: Minimum intent score
minIntentScore.description: A lead scoring below this 0-100 threshold is dropped as noise and never charged. 20 keeps light topical mentions; raise to 40+ for only active buyers.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy passed through to the child actors. Reddit needs residential; the default is recommended.
